cohort: The study included 244 13-22 year-old postpartum adolescents and young women who chose either postplacental IUDs or postpartum contraceptive implants prior to hospital discharge.
finding: IUD initiators had significantly higher pregnancy rates by 12 months (7.6% vs. 1.5%, p=0.04) primarily due to a 25% expulsion rate, while participant-requested discontinuation rates were similar between IUD and implant groups.
